title: Hyp Final Release Freeze
objective: Publish and validate the final higher-genus mathematical source, collect the remaining exact competitor and platform receipts, update the release scorecard, and enable only receipt-authenticated automatic envelopes

oracles: exact Magma/PARI and four-platform receipt digests
exceptions: Shared generated production registries, package budgets, and receipt policy are final-integration artifacts for already reviewed source-transparent mathematics

handoff.summary: Integrated the reviewed higher-genus mathematics, froze mathematical source a680c04d (framed bundle 36495206...73e1), collected exact native/dynamic and authenticated Wasm evidence on Linux x64, Linux ARM64, macOS ARM64, and Windows x64 at a9d83f82, recorded sanitizer/cache/failure evidence, and generated a fail-closed release policy with six exact GF(1009) Cantor envelopes backed by 24 normalized receipts. The final local release assembly contains the enabled policy and current 273-function Wasm coverage, passes the full 61-file portable suite, architecture, strict Python, and direct/public/browser hyperelliptic Wasm tests, and is documented as a defensible release candidate rather than a claim that every performance target passed.
risks: The small-coefficient ordinary rational-addition row remains 7.81x Magma and the genus-2 object-cold height paths remain 322--335 ms and 738--777 ms; both are declared performance misses.
Source-current Phase-9 analytic acceptance times out at 600 seconds with roughly 17 GiB RSS. Historical evidence is retained but is not presented as current acceptance.
The first artifact-cold rank-three map after a full rebuild is 1.224 seconds; the separately measured process-cold post-publication path passes at 0.532--0.563 seconds.

The four-platform receipts bind the immutable pre-allowlist mathematical artifact. The final local package hash differs because it includes the subsequently generated enabled policy and 273-function coverage metadata; the framed mathematical bundle is unchanged.
Only six exact GF(1009) model/workload cells are automatically enabled. All other operations, models, primes, and workload sizes deliberately fall back until independently receipted.
next_steps: Merge the review branch without rewriting its evidence commits and retain a9d83f82 plus the raw receipt hashes as the mathematical freeze identity.
Diagnose the Phase-9 evaluation/RSS regression before spending another acceptance run.
Revisit the two declared representation-heavy misses only after evaluating the live exact-workspace compiler slice.
Require a new source freeze and four-platform evidence before widening any automatic-selection envelope.
